case.summary: Case AC-HHF-003 is assessed as fraud with 0.94 probability under an undocumented pattern of a dormant-wake online drain across 7 transactions (3660147–3660153) totaling $8,551.47 in exposure. sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed to report an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern under internal case ID AC-HHF-003. The suspicious activity involves customer C11663 and mastercard debit card C11663-K1, which connects to 5 peer cards (C04096-K1, C07847-K1, C08563-K1, C09026-K1, and C09148-K1) through a shared telemetry signature. Between 2017-01-22 and 2017-01-31, card C11663-K1 engaged in a dormant-wake online drain of 7 online product code C transactions without identity records: transaction 3660147 on 2017-01-22 at 12:55 for $181.73 in region 327.0, transaction 3660148 on 2017-01-23 at 07:25 for $357.82 in region 327.0, transaction 3660149 on 2017-01-24 at 19:13 for $811.92 in region 327.0, transaction 3660150 on 2017-01-26 at 19:51 for $1,800.00 in region 327.0, transaction 3660151 on 2017-01-27 at 19:12 for $1,800.00 in region 327.0, transaction 3660152 on 2017-01-28 at 17:31 for $1,800.00 in region 327.0, and transaction 3660153 on 2017-01-31 at 17:31 for $1,800.00 in region 315.0. Customer C11663 submitted a message stating they did not make transaction 3660153. This escalating series matches a coordinated pattern across 6 cards exhibiting the same dormant-wake doubling ramp. Prior to opening on 2017-01-31, card C11663-K1 had 57 transactions with a median amount of $91.98, making this rapid series totaling $8,551.47 highly unusual and inconsistent with historical baseline activity. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. The bank opened case AC-HHF-003, initiated monitoring of connected cards, and escalated the case to an analyst, while a block of card C11663-K1 and this report filing are recommended and await fraud-manager approval for total suspicious activity of $8,551.47.
